title: The trading town
summary: On the way to the real Divine Wood Palace ruins, Wen Qingxuan says the minor divine art in a Wood God Tablet could gravely wound a first-grade Sovereign, but is hard to use. She takes North Heaven into the Relic Continent's trading town, where she makes a show of holding Mu Chen's hand, and later buys him a combat spiritual pill and the formation map of the level-5 Small Thousand Sword Spiritual Formation as an 'investment'. Mu Fengyang and Zhao Qingshan lose at a rigged Alliance gambling table run by Mr. Qin, and Mu Chen breaks its hidden spiritual formations, laid by the Alliance boss Xiao Huang, to win their way out. At the Star Hall of the Infinite Flame Realm, Xiao Xiao reports that Blood race spies have bribed Luo race elders to back a marriage between Luo Li and the Blood race. Xiao Yan and Yao Chen recall how Qing Yanjing of the Ancient Pagoda Clan refused a match with Mohe Tian and chose a man of low standing. The Alliance brothers then set off for Wood God Mountain.
